description: Replace the text of a comment on an issue or pull request (by comment id). Its author or a repository writer only; the previous text is kept in the edit history; the same text again is `unchanged`; a concurrent edit is a conflict, never overwritten. Mentions the edit adds are notified. Mirrors PATCH /api/v3/repos/:o/:r/issues/comments/:id. Returns {id, kind, number, effect}.

body.description: The new text (Markdown); the previous text is kept in the edit history

comment_id.description: The comment's id (as listed by gluecron_list_pr_comments, or the #comment-<id> anchor)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_edit_comment
